Karthik Iyer
karthik.iyer.dev@gmail.com | +91 98xxxxxx03 | github.com/kiyer | Chennai
SUMMARY
Backend-focused developer with strong Java and Spring Boot fundamentals. Some exposure to frontend basics
through college coursework but limited hands-on React experience.
EDUCATION
B.E. Computer Science, PES University (2023-2027), CGPA: 8.2/10
SKILLS
Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, MySQL, REST APIs, HTML/CSS, basic JavaScript, Git, Postman, Maven
PROJECTS
Library Management System
•
Built a REST API backend in Spring Boot with MySQL for a college library system
•
Basic HTML/CSS frontend to consume the APIs; no frontend framework used
Student Attendance Tracker
•
Java console-based application with MySQL database integration
CERTIFICATIONS
Java Programming Masterclass (Udemy)
